pli-tv-kd12:1.1.29: bhattañca → ayaṃ casaddo yuropiyamarammarāmaññapotthakesu na dissati.
pli-tv-kd12:1.4.28: tabbīso → yu. ma. potthakesu vīsoti pāṭho bhavati. | taṃ → ayaṃ taṃsaddo yu. ma. potthakesu na pañañāyati.
pli-tv-kd12:3.1.2: bhikkhū → idaṃ te bhikkhūti padadvayaṃ yu. ma. potthakesu na dissati.
pli-tv-kd12:3.2.2: sakkonti → yebhuyyena na sakkontīti pāṭho dissati. ettha nasaddena paṭisedho ayuttarūpoyeva parivāsasamādānassa sodhetuṃ samatthakāle bhagavatā anujāniyamānattā. purato vakkhamāne mānattasamādānepi eseva nayo.
pli-tv-kd12:5.1.36: ārocāpetabbaṃ → mānattārahena bhikkhave …pe…  dūtenapi ārocāpetabbanti ayaṃ pāṭho yu. ma. rāmaññapotthakesu na dissati.
pli-tv-kd12:7.1.5: carati → onogaṇena caratītipi onogaṇe caratītipi pāṭho dissati. yu. potthake ūne gaṇe caraṇantīti pāṭho pana āgato.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.79: bhikkhūnaṃ → yu. ma. pārivāsikā sādenti pakatattāna bhikkhunā.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.82: āsanaṃ → yu. abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalisāmiyaṃ āsanaṃ ma. abhivādanaṃ paccuṭṭhānaṃ añjalisāmiyaṃ āsanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.85: pesalā → yu. ma. seyyābhihāraṃ pādodakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ pattaṃ nahāne parikammaṃ ujjhāyanti ca pesalā.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.91: gacchare → yu. ma. sammā ca vattanā tattha pakatattassa gacchanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.93: samaṇena → yu. ma. yo ca hoti pariyanto pure pacchā tatheva ca.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.97: sabhikkhuko → yu. ma. pavāraṇā ca dūto ca gantabbañca sabhikkhuke.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.99: nisajjite → yu. ekacchanne va vatthabbaṃ tatheva ca nimantaye. ma. ekacchanne ca vuṭṭhānaṃ tatheva ca nimantaye.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.101: ca → yu. ma. āsane nīcacaṅkame. chamāya caṅkame na ca.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.105: pārivāsikā → yu. ma. nikkhipanaṃ samādānaṃ ratti vā pārivāsike.
pli-tv-kd12:9.1.109: puna → yu. abbhānāraho yo cāpi sambhedaṃ nayato puna. ma. abbhānārahena yo cāpi sambhedaṃ nayato puna.
